statement: Whenever close_strings(word1, word2) returns a result r, r = true if and only if all three conditions hold: (a) len(word1) = len(word2); (b) for every lowercase letter c, c occurs in word1 if and only if c occurs in word2; (c) for every integer k >= 1, the number of lowercase letters occurring exactly k times in word1 equals the number of lowercase letters occurring exactly k times in word2. Thus r = false exactly when at least one of (a), (b), (c) fails. An occurrence of c in a slice w means an index i with 0 <= i < len(w) and w[i] = c.
preconditions: 1 <= len(word1) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(word2) <= 100000; every byte of word1 and word2 lies in the inclusive range 97..122 (lowercase English letters).

statement: The call close_strings(word1, word2) returns a result (a Bool) and does not fail, panic, overflow, or go out of bounds for every word1 and word2 satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(word1) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(word2) <= 100000; every byte of word1 and word2 lies in the inclusive range 97..122 (lowercase English letters).

statement: Whenever close_strings(word1, word2) returns a result r, r = false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(word1) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(word2) <= 100000; every byte of word1 and word2 lies in the inclusive range 97..122; len(word1) != len(word2).

statement: Whenever close_strings(word1, word2) returns true, for every lowercase letter c, c occurs in word1 if and only if c occurs in word2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(word1) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(word2) <= 100000; every byte of word1 and word2 lies in the inclusive range 97..122.

statement: Whenever close_strings(word1, word2) returns true, for every integer k >= 1, the number of lowercase letters occurring exactly k times in word1 equals the number of lowercase letters occurring exactly k times in word2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(word1) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(word2) <= 100000; every byte of word1 and word2 lies in the inclusive range 97..122.

statement: Whenever close_strings(word1, word2) returns a result r, r = true.
preconditions: 1 <= len(word1) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(word2) <= 100000; every byte of word1 and word2 lies in the inclusive range 97..122; for every lowercase letter c, the number of occurrences of c in word1 equals the number of occurrences of c in word2.

statement: Whenever close_strings(word1, word2) returns r and close_strings(word2, word1) returns r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(word1) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(word2) <= 100000; every byte of word1 and word2 lies in the inclusive range 97..122.

statement: For every byte slice word1' with 1 <= len(word1') <= 100000, all bytes in 97..122, len(word1') = len(word1), and the same number of occurrences of every lowercase letter as word1, whenever close_strings(word1, word2) returns r and close_strings(word1', word2) returns r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(word1) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(word2) <= 100000; every byte of word1 and word2 lies in the inclusive range 97..122.

statement: For every byte slice word2' with 1 <= len(word2') <= 100000, all bytes in 97..122, len(word2') = len(word2), and the same number of occurrences of every lowercase letter as word2, whenever close_strings(word1, word2) returns r and close_strings(word1, word2') returns r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(word1) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(word2) <= 100000; every byte of word1 and word2 lies in the inclusive range 97..122.

statement: For every bijection sigma from the set of lowercase letter bytes {97,...,122} to itself, let word1' and word2' be the slices defined by len(word1') = len(word1), len(word2') = len(word2), word1'[i] = sigma(word1[i]) for 0 <= i < len(word1), and word2'[j] = sigma(word2[j]) for 0 <= j < len(word2). Whenever close_strings(word1, word2) returns r and close_strings(word1', word2') returns r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(word1) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(word2) <= 100000; every byte of word1 and word2 lies in the inclusive range 97..122.

statement: For every pair of distinct lowercase letters c and d that both occur in word1, let word1' be obtained from word1 by replacing every occurrence of c with d and every occurrence of d with c, leaving all other bytes unchanged. Whenever close_strings(word1, word2) returns r and close_strings(word1', word2) returns r', we have r = r'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(word1) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(word2) <= 100000; every byte of word1 and word2 lies in the inclusive range 97..122.

statement: Whenever close_strings(word1, word2) returns a result r, r = true if and only if c = d and len(word1) = len(word2).
preconditions: 1 <= len(word1) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(word2) <= 100000; every byte of word1 and word2 lies in the inclusive range 97..122; there exist lowercase letters c and d such that every byte of word1 equals c and every byte of word2 equals d.

statement: Whenever close_strings(word1, word2) returns true, let S be the set of lowercase letters occurring in word1. Then S is also the set of lowercase letters occurring in word2, and there exists a bijection f from S to S such that, for every c in S, the number of occurrences of f(c) in word2 equals the number of occurrences of c in word1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(word1) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(word2) <= 100000; every byte of word1 and word2 lies in the inclusive range 97..122.

statement: Whenever close_strings(word1, word2) returns a result r, r = true if and only if for every integer k >= 1, the number of lowercase letters occurring exactly k times in word1 equals the number of lowercase letters occurring exactly k times in word2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(word1) <= 100000 and 1 <= len(word2) <= 100000; every byte of word1 and word2 lies in the inclusive range 97..122; len(word1) = len(word2); for every lowercase letter c, c occurs in word1 if and only if c occurs in word2.
